techniques.name: Brute Force
techniques.text: Adversaries may use brute force techniques to gain access to accounts by repeatedly attempting login with guessed or leaked credentials.

techniques.name: Valid Accounts
techniques.text: Adversaries may obtain and abuse credentials of existing accounts to gain access, maintain persistence, and blend in with normal traffic.

techniques.name: Remote Services
techniques.text: Adversaries may use valid accounts to log into remote services such as SSH or RDP to move laterally within an environment.

techniques.name: Account Manipulation
techniques.text: Adversaries may add, modify, or use existing accounts and their permissions to maintain access to a victim environment.

techniques.name: Scheduled Task/Job
techniques.text: Adversaries may abuse task scheduling functionality to execute code at system startup or on a scheduled basis for persistence.

techniques.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter
techniques.text: Adversaries may abuse command and script interpreters to execute commands, scripts, or binaries on a compromised host.

techniques.name: Application Layer Protocol
techniques.text: Adversaries may communicate with a compromised host using application layer protocols to blend C2 traffic with existing network traffic.

techniques.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
techniques.text: Adversaries may encrypt data on target systems to interrupt availability and extort the victim organization for a ransom payment.
